used_dialogues: That voice, I know it instantly.
Jisoo? No, that is impossible here.
You still have it, I see.
How did you recognize me so fast?
I kept it since we were kids.
Five years apart, yet he remembers.
Let us walk to the library.
Okay, I have missed this feeling.
Do you remember our promise to you?
He wants to talk about the past.
I never stopped thinking about you.
I am so glad we found each other.
Stay with me, please do not leave.
I will always be right here for you.
Your stance is completely wrong.
Why does this guy annoy me so much?
She is getting dangerously close to me.
You are holding back, aren't you?
I never lose to anyone.
His pride makes him impossible to read.
Why did I help her with that move?
Thank you, that actually made sense.
Stop looking at me like that.
Is his face turning red in the dark?
I cannot let her leave my side.
Are you afraid of losing to me?
I only fight to win against you.
So that is why he kept pushing me.
I am finally ready to surrender to her.
Then let us compete for the rest of our lives.
